#### Payload `construction.definition`

`ConstructionNode.definitionJson` (`ConstructionDefinition`). A changed `kind` replaces the whole definition (atomic); otherwise field by field, each `ConstructionRef` one value that must resolve (its `nodeId`, tracked `trackedId`/`incidentEdgeIds`, and `featureIndex` remapped like a timeline position).

- union on `kind` (any other)
  - any other `kind`
    - any other field: atomic of ref → construction-ref

#### Payload `parametric.features`

`ParametricBodyNode.featuresJson` (`FeatureData[]`). The timeline: order is geometry. Parameters one by one; a selection (edges, profiles, tools, a source face) is one value — the user picked it as a whole. A feature type this build does not know merges its base fields and treats the rest as one value each.

- list of `feature` by `id` (timeline order)
  - union on `type` (extrude, revolve, fillet, chamfer, boolean, any other)
    - `type: "extrude"`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - `sketchId`: ref → node
      - `source`: atomic { nodeId: ref → node; profiles: atomic of ref → profile }
      - `depth`: expression
      - `symmetric`: scalar
      - `startOffset`: expression
      - `operation`: scalar
      - `profiles`: atomic of ref → profile
    - `type: "revolve"`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - `sketchId`: ref → node
      - `axis`: atomic
      - `axisSource`: atomic { nodeId: ref → node; edge: ref → edge }
      - `constructionAxisRef`: ref → construction-ref
      - `angle`: expression
      - `profiles`: atomic of ref → profile
    - `type: "fillet"`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - `radius`: expression
      - `edges`: atomic of ref → edge
    - `type: "chamfer"`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - `distance`: expression
      - `edges`: atomic of ref → edge
    - `type: "boolean"`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - `operation`: scalar
      - `toolIds`: atomic of ref → node
      - `consumeTools`: scalar
    - any other `type`
      - `id`: scalar
      - `type`: scalar
      - `suppressed`: scalar
      - `name`: scalar
      - any other field: atomic

#### Payload `sketch.data`

`SketchNode.dataJson` (`SketchData`). Entities, constraints, dimension anchors and external references are keyed by id; an entity's `params` is one value (its geometry), a constraint's `refs` one value that must resolve. The resolution results of an external reference (`type`, `snapshot`, `dangling`) are recomputed by the rebuild. The legacy id counters merge by max / min.

- `entities`: list of `entity` by `id` (stable order)
  - `id`: scalar
  - `type`: scalar
  - `params`: atomic
  - `construction`: scalar
- `constraints`: list of `constraint` by `id` (stable order)
  - `id`: scalar
  - `kind`: scalar
  - `refs`: atomic of { entityId: ref → sketch-entity; pointIndex: scalar }
  - `datum`: expression
  - `datums`: atomic of expression
  - `blockedParams`: atomic
  - `direction`: atomic
- `anchors`: list of `anchor` by `id` (stable order)
  - `id`: ref → sketch-constraint
  - `anchor`: atomic
- `externalRefs`: list of `external` by `entityId` (stable order)
  - `entityId`: scalar
  - `nodeId`: ref → node
  - `edge`: ref → edge
  - `role`: scalar
  - `pinned`: scalar
  - `type`: derived
  - `snapshot`: derived
  - `dangling`: derived
- `refPositions`: map of timeline-position (body = map key)
- `entityIdSeq`: max
- `externalIdSeq`: min

#### Payload `sketch.planeRef`

`SketchNode.planeRefJson` (`PlaneFaceRef`): the face the sketch sits on, one value; its node and tracked face must resolve.

- atomic { nodeId: ref → node; faceId: ref → plane-face }
